"""design_A1C2 모델링 준비: 예측 시점(tp)별 코호트·라벨·특성 표와 분할 배정을 만든다.
모델 학습·성능 계산은 하지 않는다. 설계서·원자료는 읽기만 한다."""
import json
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

WS = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
D = WS / "data"
OUT = WS / "prep"
design = json.loads((WS / "design_A1C2.json").read_text())

pat = pd.read_csv(D / "patients.csv.gz")
adm = pd.read_csv(D / "admissions.csv.gz", parse_dates=["admit_time", "discharge_time"])
labs = pd.read_csv(D / "labs.csv.gz", parse_dates=["collect_time", "report_time"])
dx = pd.read_csv(D / "diagnoses.csv.gz")
H = pd.Timedelta(hours=1)

# --- 예측 시점 전개: 입원 + offset, 재원 중인 tp만 ---
tps = adm.merge(pd.DataFrame({"offset_h": design["tp"]["offsets_h"]}), how="cross")
tps["tp"] = tps.admit_time + tps.offset_h * H
tps = tps[tps.tp < tps.discharge_time].copy()
tps["window_end"] = tps.tp + 48 * H
tps["window_censored"] = tps.window_end > tps.discharge_time
tps = tps.merge(pat, on="patient_id", how="left")

cr = labs[labs.test == "creatinine"][["admission_id", "value", "collect_time", "report_time"]]
cr_by_adm = {k: g.sort_values("collect_time") for k, g in cr.groupby("admission_id")}


def kdigo_hits(c, times, values, ref_mask):
    """측정 c(시간 t, 값 v)가 KDIGO 크레아티닌 기준을 만족하는지 (ref_mask 범위의 이전 값과 비교)."""
    t, v = c
    prior48 = values[ref_mask & (times < t) & (times >= t - 48 * H)]
    prior7d = values[ref_mask & (times < t) & (times >= t - 168 * H)]
    return (len(prior48) and v - prior48.min() >= 0.3) or (len(prior7d) and v >= 1.5 * prior7d.min())


rows = []
for r in tps.itertuples():
    g = cr_by_adm.get(r.admission_id)
    known_aki, label, n_out = False, 0, 0
    if g is not None:
        # 제외: tp까지 '보고된' 크레아티닌만으로 KDIGO AKI가 확인되는가
        rep = g[(g.report_time >= r.admit_time) & (g.report_time <= r.tp)]
        t, v = rep.collect_time.values, rep.value.values
        m = np.ones(len(rep), bool)
        known_aki = any(kdigo_hits((ti, vi), t, v, m) for ti, vi in zip(t, v))
        # 결과: [tp, tp+48h) 채취값, 기준값은 tp-168h 이후 채취값
        t, v = g.collect_time.values, g.value.values
        ref = t >= np.datetime64(r.tp - 168 * H)
        out = (t >= np.datetime64(r.tp)) & (t < np.datetime64(r.window_end))
        n_out = int(out.sum())
        label = int(any(kdigo_hits((ti, vi), t, v, ref) for ti, vi in zip(t[out], v[out])))
    rows.append((known_aki, label, n_out))
tps[["aki_known_by_tp", "aki_48h", "n_cr_in_outcome_window"]] = pd.DataFrame(rows, index=tps.index)

# --- 코호트 ---
tps["incl_adult"] = tps.age >= 18
cohort = tps[tps.incl_adult & ~tps.aki_known_by_tp].copy()

# --- 특성: tp까지 보고된 검사값 ---
def lab_feat(test, start_h, agg):
    x = labs[labs.test == test][["admission_id", "value", "report_time"]].merge(
        cohort[["admission_id", "tp", "admit_time"]].reset_index(), on="admission_id")
    lo = x.admit_time if start_h is None else x.tp - start_h * H
    x = x[(x.report_time >= lo) & (x.report_time <= x.tp)].sort_values("report_time")
    return x.groupby("index").value.agg(agg)

for f in design["features"]:
    if f["source"] == "labs":
        s = f["window"]["start"]
        start_h = None if s == "admit" else int(s.replace("tp-", "").rstrip("h"))
        agg = {"last": "last", "min": "min", "max": "max", "count": "size"}[f["agg"]]
        cohort[f["name"]] = lab_feat(f["filter"]["test"][0], start_h, agg)
        if agg == "size":
            cohort[f["name"]] = cohort[f["name"]].fillna(0).astype(int)
    elif f["source"] == "diagnoses":
        # 시간 정보가 없는 퇴원 진단 — 설계 문제로 보고, 별도 열로만 보관
        cohort[f["name"] + "_FLAGGED"] = cohort.admission_id.map(dx.groupby("admission_id").size()).fillna(0).astype(int)
    # admissions/patients 값 특성(unit, age, sex)은 이미 병합되어 있음

# --- 분할: family_id 결측 시 patient_id로 대체한 그룹 키 ---
cohort["split_group"] = cohort.family_id.fillna(cohort.patient_id)
groups = np.array(sorted(cohort.split_group.unique()))
rng = np.random.default_rng(design["split"]["seed"])
test_groups = set(rng.permutation(groups)[: int(round(len(groups) * design["split"]["test_fraction"]))])
cohort["split"] = np.where(cohort.split_group.isin(test_groups), "test", "train")

cols = ["admission_id", "patient_id", "family_id", "split_group", "split", "offset_h", "tp",
        "discharge_time", "discharge_status", "window_censored", "n_cr_in_outcome_window", "aki_48h"] + \
       [f["name"] for f in design["features"] if f["source"] != "diagnoses"] + ["n_dx_FLAGGED"]
cohort[cols].to_csv(OUT / "cohort_tp_dataset.csv.gz", index=False)

summary = {
    "tp_candidates_total": int(len(adm) * len(design["tp"]["offsets_h"])),
    "tp_in_admission": int(len(tps)),
    "excluded_aki_known_by_tp": int(tps.aki_known_by_tp.sum()),
    "cohort_rows": int(len(cohort)),
    "cohort_admissions": int(cohort.admission_id.nunique()),
    "cohort_patients": int(cohort.patient_id.nunique()),
    "label_positive_rate": float(cohort.aki_48h.mean()),
    "window_censored_rate": float(cohort.window_censored.mean()),
    "no_cr_in_outcome_window_rate": float((cohort.n_cr_in_outcome_window == 0).mean()),
    "family_id_missing_rate_patients": float(pat.family_id.isna().mean()),
    "split_rows": cohort.split.value_counts().to_dict(),
    "split_pos_rate": cohort.groupby("split").aki_48h.mean().to_dict(),
    "missing_rate": cohort[[f["name"] for f in design["features"] if f["source"] == "labs"]].isna().mean().round(4).to_dict(),
}
(OUT / "prep_summary.json").write_text(json.dumps(summary, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, default=str))
print(json.dumps(summary, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, default=str))
